findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed multiple sanitizer buckets at 10 ppm chlorine bleach. CORRECTED- buckets were remade to 100 ppm Cl. Ensure sanitizers used for food contact surfaces are made and tested to be at concentrations recommended by the manufacturer's label.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.

findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspector observed light coming in along the left perimeter of the back door. Outer opening shall be protected from the entry of pests. Ensure weather stripping is placed to prevent gaps in the door, where pests may enter by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Multiple wet mop heads were observed to be stored in the empty basin of the mop bucket (kitchen and lobby mop sink). CORRECTED- Education about mop storage was conducted, and mop heads were moved to top of the mop bucket so they bristles could air dry. Ensure used mops are positioned to air dry to prevent the growth and harborage of bacteria with high water activity.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16 (A)(2) Diced tomatoes in the 3rd line reach-in cooler were observed with internal temperature of 50F-51F. Another portion of diced tomatoes had an internal temperature of 51F-54F in 1st line cold rail. The product in 1st line cold rail was thought to be from the portion held in 3rd line reach-in. Tomatoes in question were discarded. 
Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as a public health control, cold TCS foods shall be maintained at 41F/below.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.citation_text:
4-301.11 Third line reach-in cooler was holding at 50F. Cheese shreds and diced tomatoes held in the cooler were discarded. Call for service was made and will occur on 6/14/22. See general comments for additional information. 
Equipment holding cold food shall be sufficient in number and capacity to maintain proper temperature of TCS foods.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12 Employee was observed shutting off the manual faucet without a barrier during handwashing. Proper technique was discussed, and employee acknowledged they know and understand how to properly wash their hands. Ensure proper handwashing technique is used every time employees wash their hands.
Food employees shall properly wash their hands with the following procedure: (1) rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) apply soap; (3) rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds; (4) thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying. To avoid recontaminating hands, use a disposable paper towel or similar clean barrier when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a handwashing sink.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Ice was observed in the basin of the handwashing sink by the drive. Inspector showed one of the managers prior to washing hands and advised on proper use of handwashing sinks. Ensure handwashing sinks are used only for handwashing and not used as dump sinks or for any other purposes. 
Handwashing sinks are to be accessible at all times and used only for handwashing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Sanitizer solutions in sani-buckets and at 3 part sink were at 0ppm chlorine. Solutions were prepared recently, but it was determined the employee who prepared the solutions forgot to add sanitizer. Manager added sanitizer to provide proper concentration of 100ppm. 
A chlorine solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration of solutions.

 A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Buildup was observed in the Mountain Dew and Pepsi soda nozzles at the drive thru soda machine. Management was made aware and advised to clean and sanitize nozzles and diffusers daily/as needed to eliminate buildup.
Equipment such as beverage dispensing nozzles shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Sanitizer solution at 3 part sink was observed at 50ppm chlorine. Solution was prepared earlier that morning, and the basin was full to the top with water. PIC noted whoever setup the sink may have left it running and possibly diluted the solution. Dishes were not yet done for the day, but the sanitize basin had food debris in it also. Solution was discarded and basin was cleaned prior to preparation of fresh sanitizer at proper concentration of 100ppm for ware washing. 
A chlorine solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration of solutions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Metal probe of food thermometer in back prep was observed with stuck on food debris. Probe was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. 
Food temperature measuring devices shall be cleaned before use or storage. Clean and sanitize the stems of food thermometers between uses. If sanitizer solution is used for wiping the thermometer probe during prep, then make sure the metal probe is cleaned and sanitized up to every 4 hours after continuous use.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:

Sanitizer shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.citation_text:

DRIVE THRU: Buildup of debris was observed in the corner under the cash register, and general debris was observed under tables.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114 Solution in sani-buckets was observed at 0ppm chlorine. Solutions were prepared with a solution at the 3 part sink that had not yet been changed. Sanitizer solution was changed to allow for proper concentration of 100ppm for ware washing and sani-buckets.
A chlorine solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration of solutions.

4-702.11 Equipment was observed soaking in the third basin of the 3 part sink where sanitize step occurs for ware washing. The solution was observed at 0ppm chlorine. Employee noted the solution had not yet been changed. Solution was emptied and remade. Equipment was placed in solution at proper concentration after re-washing and rinsing. 
Submerge dishes in chlorine based sanitizer solution for at least 10 seconds prior to removing to air dry. Utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use after cleaning.

4-602.11 Metal probe of food thermometer in back prep was observed with stuck on food debris from morning temperature checks. Thermometer had not yet been used during afternoon prep. Metal probe and surfaces around it were cleaned and sanitized prior to use. 
Food temperature measuring devices shall be cleaned before use or storage. Clean and sanitize the stems of food thermometers between uses. If sanitizer solution is used for wiping the thermometer probe during prep, then make sure the metal probe is cleaned and sanitized up to every 4 hours after continuous use.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Mold buildup was observed on the sides of the ice shoot at the lobby soda machine. Ensure proper cleaning and sanitizing as needed to eliminate buildup. 
Equipment such as drink nozzles and ice shoots shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Gloves used properly
findings.citation_text:
3-304.15 Employee returned to the make line after entering the walkin cooler with gloved hands. Employee was preparing to continue with food prep without changing gloves. Employee was advised on proper glove use after touching general surfaces such as the handles of the walkin cooler. Gloves were discarded. Employee washed his hands prior to putting on a new pair of gloves to continue with food prep.
Single use gloves shall be used for only one task, used for no other purpose, and discarded when damaged or soiled, or when interruptions occur in the operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114 Solutions in sani-buckets were observed at a concentration less than 100ppm chlorine. The label directions for product in use show a required concentration of 100ppm. Solutions were remade using the freshly prepared solution available at the 3 part sink, which was observed at 100ppm. 
A chemical sanitizer shall be used in accordance with EPA-registered label use instructions. Maintain solutions at 100ppm per label instructions, and use test strips to verify concentration of bleach solutions.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Scissor used for opening seasoning packets was observed soiled and stored in the knife rack for use. Scissor was removed and taken to dish area for ware washing. 
Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is not time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned and time when contamination may have occurred or at least every 24hrs.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-102.11 A spray bottle labeled Kayquat ii Sanitizer was observed in the chemical closet. The solution registered at 0ppm with inspector's quat and chlorine test strips. Manager noted the bottle should contain the sanitizer that is used at the 3 part sink, which is a chlorine not quat based sanitizer. Facility does not have a quat sanitizer available for use. Solution was emptied, and two bottles with the label of Kayquat ii were discarded in the trash by the GM. (See general comments for additional information)
Working containers used for storing poisonous or toxic materials such as cleaners and sanitizers taken from bulk supplies and/or prepared on-site (bleach solution) shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14 Manager checking cooking temperatures had a wet wiping cloth sitting out of solution for use. The stem of the probe thermometer was getting wiped with said cloth between uses. Proper storage of a wiping cloth in sanitizer solution between uses was discussed. A sanitizer solution was provided for proper storage of wiping cloth during use. 
Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution maintained at proper concentration for the sanitizer product being used.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text:
4-202.11 Hard plastic top of knife storage rack was pitted and flakes of plastic were observed on surfaces of recently cleaned knives. Rack was removed from wall; GM stated a new knife storage rack would be ordered.
Multiuse food-contact surfaces shall be smooth and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, inclusions, pits, and similar imperfections.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

B) surfaces under/between steamers (food debris).
Nonfood contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to eliminate buildup of grease, food splash and general debris.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.160 & 510 - Employee did not change gloves between tasks and went from wiping down surfaces with a cloth from sanitizer solution to chopping cilantro. After being advised on handwashing and glove use by a manager, employee was observed having bare hand contact with the manual faucet prior to drying hands. Proper handwashing and glove use were discussed, and manager had the employee re-wash hands with proper technique prior to getting a new pair of gloves to continue with prep. Cilantro that was being chopped was discarded.

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time hands may have been contaminated, before putting on gloves/between glove changes, and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles. 
Gloves are intended for one use and must be changed between tasks and then they become soiled, torn, or an interruption in task occurs.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 & 512 - Employee was observed changing gloves after handling a sanitizer wiping cloth and prior to preparing orders for customers but did not wash hands between glove changes. Handwashing between glove changes was discussed with employee and management.

Employees shall properly wash their hands before putting on gloves/between glove changes, any time hands may have been contaminated and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) counter under steamers (grease/food debris);   and
B) floor fans (dust buildup).

Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of splash and debris.
This includes ledges where sanitizer pans used to be stored on the north end of the make line and inside cabinets beneath handsinks.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
(R) 750.510 - Employee was observed washing hands without proper technique. Barrier was not used to shut off the manual faucet at conclusion of handwashing. Proper handwashing technique was discussed with the employee. Hands were rewashed properly prior to continuing on to the next task. 

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time hands may have been contaminated and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - A) (R) Ice shoots on soda machines were observed with mold accumulation along side seams. 
Mountain Dew nozzle and diffuser at drive thru machine were soiled with mold accumulation. Nozzle and diffuser were switched out during inspection. Manager began cleaning ice shoots as well. 
Clean and sanitize ice shoots and soda nozzles/diffusers daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of mold.

B) Wall mounted knife rack was soiled with some debris accumulation on the top plastic holding compartment. When the top compartment was removed it was possible to determine the inner surface of the metal portion was also soiled with general buildup. Knife rack was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. 

Properly clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
(R) 750.880 - Cinnamon blend was observed in the bottom of the storage pan for soufflé cups (observed next to cinnamon blend). Container was removed from storage area to be cleaned. Manager was advised to consider providing a lid for the storage container to help prevent buildup in the bottom.
Store soufflé cups in a clean container, and maintain storage areas clean.

Single service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(R) 750.1220 - Floor along walls and in corners was soiled with buildup of general debris under the lobby drink counter. The floor drain for the lobby soda machine also had heavy mold accumulation inside (visible from opening inside cabinet). Thoroughly clean the floor and drain under the lobby soda machine. 

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text:
750.280 - Soufflé cup was observed as a scoop inside cinnamon blend. Use a proper scoop with a handle to dispense foods. 

To avoid unnecessary manual contact with food, suitable dispensing utensils shall be used by employees.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 - Employees were observed washing hands without proper technique. Barriers were not used to shut off manual faucets at conclusion of handwashing. Proper handwashing technique was discussed with all staff. 

Proper glove use was also discussed. Employee on fry line was going between tasks and not changing gloves. Gloves need not be worn unless staff are having direct contact with ready to eat food (i.e. making orders, etc.). However, if gloves are worn they must be used properly and changed between touching surfaces unrelated to food prep. 

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time hands may have been contaminated and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles. 
Gloves shall be single use and used for only 1 task.  Gloves shall be discarded when damaged, soiled or after an interruption in operations.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Sani-bucket at front counter tested at 0ppm chlorine. Solution was remade to be at proper concentration (100ppm).

Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. Maintain solution at proper concentration and change every 2-4hrs or more frequently if solutions and wiping cloths become heavily soiled. These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean

Clean and sanitize ice shoots daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of mold.

Single service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text:

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
